about.title: Our Story
about.subtitle:
A real story. Real pain. A real mission.
EaseMind was born from a struggle that changed our lives.

origin.title: Where it all began
origin.p1: Before any app, method, or idea existed… there was pain. My wife faced Anxiety and Panic crises so intense that our routine became survival. We sought psychologists, therapists, doctors — and each day felt like a new battle.
origin.p2: But we didn't give up. We walked together, embracing fear, insecurity, sleepless nights, tears that only those who live through this understand.
origin.p3: Over time, healing came. And with it, something even more powerful: purpose.
origin.p4: My wife decided to study and become a Therapist. She wanted to help others not feel alone in the dark as she once did. And I, a programmer, began to realize that technology could also be healing — if used with love, empathy, and truth.
origin.p5: That's how EaseMind was born: not as an app, but as a continuation of our story.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.p1: No one should face anxiety without support. No one should suffer because they can't afford weekly therapy. No one should feel like they're fighting alone.
list: ✨ Accessible — because mental health is a right, not a luxury
✨ Welcoming — because we know exactly how this pain hurts
✨ Effective — cutting-edge technology guiding you with real empathy
mission.p3: This app is not a product. It's the bridge we wished we had found back then.

team.title: Who We Are
team.desc: We're a couple who turned pain into purpose. She, a trained therapist with a personal story of overcoming. He, a programmer passionate about creating solutions that truly make a difference.
team.desc2: Together, we created EaseMind so no one has to face alone what we faced. If you're here today, know this: this app was made thinking of you.
team.desc3: You are not alone. You never were. And you never will be.
